NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of the immovableproperty, described in the following schedule, since this land required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board,for the construction of Water Storage Tank of Asian Development V project under Chilaw Water Supply Scheme

RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning andWater Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,15th February, 2016.5/2/2/1156SCHEDULE

An allotment of land called Lunupitiyawatta, situated at Lunupitiyawatta Village in the Grama Niladhari Divisionof No. 568, Munneshwarama, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Chilaw in Puttalam District and shown as LotNo. 02 of Plan No. 2349 prepared by Power Survey or Mr. J. P. P. R. Jayasundara of containing in extent about 0.224Hectares (2 rood, 8.5 perches) and bounded as follows :—

North by:Lot No. 01 of the Plan No. 2349 and remaining portion of the same land ;East by:The land claimed by National Water Supply and Drinage ;South by:The canal ;West by:Land portion of Lot letter B in the Plan No. 410A.
Name and addresses of the claimants :01.Mrs. Kanagasabe Rajamani,Kanapathi Hotel, Munneshwaram,Chilaw.
